answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 41148 Country: India Title: conditions for umrah Question: I just want to know that to perform Umrah is it compulsory to shave which body parts completely for men. Answer ID: 41148 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1428/909/L=1433) It is necessary only to shave the head or cut the hair of head equal to the finger tip in order to be halal from Umrah. There is no need to shave the hair of any other part of the boy for Umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
